content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ARCI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ARCI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the ARCI Recruitment 2026 is 17th September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available for the posts of Senior Manager, Manager, and Technical Coordinator in the ARCI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Technical Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Technical Coordinator post is a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology or a Master's degree in Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Manager post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Manager post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Manager post ranges from ₹1,00,000 to ₹1,50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for ARCI Recruitment 2026 is online only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening/short-listing based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual engagement on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
